title: Haze4K conditional content-aligned region measurement qualification
rationale: The archived taper route precisely failed: mean worst-held-out-partition regret was 0.134003 dB and its one-sided 95 percent lower bound 0.118104 dB remained above the frozen 0.10 dB maximum, while matched box reproduction and achieved precision passed. Its same-origin diagnostics did not support simple boundary tapering as sufficient and left mismatch of the fixed content-agnostic spatial unit unresolved. This orthogonal Stage-1 route changes only grid_definition to a deterministic source-only edge-watershed region unit. It keeps the official model, 100 development scenes, 400 nested haze variants, three hard actions, four phases, RGB-MSE/PSNR target, 0.10 dB margin, uncertainty, controls, and safety gates frozen. The taper path is recomputed from the same inference and must reproduce its archived mean within 1e-8 dB. No terminal authorizes Stage 2.

orthogonal_changes.reason: Replace only the fixed content-agnostic tile/taper spatial unit with a source-only edge-watershed region partition while preserving model, data, actions, outcomes, margins, controls, grouping, and terminal mappings.

scientific_contract.question: On the isolated 100-scene Haze4K development partition, does a deterministic source-only content-aligned region projection of conditional three-action GT utility have less than 0.10 dB worst-held-out-partition PSNR regret with adequate precision, exact taper reproduction, location specificity, non-clipping direction, and SSIM/color safety?

intervention.primary_variable: source-region mean RGB-MSE utility projected through four deterministic hazy-only edge-watershed partitions with fixed 32-pixel marker spacing and phases (0,0), (0,16), (16,0), and (16,16)
intervention.reference: the same haze condition's held-out-region GT-selected oracle over weaken 0.8, keep 1.0, and strengthen 1.2
intervention.matched_budget: one frozen official ConvIR-B inference per each of 400 nested haze conditions followed by deterministic replay of the same three actions; content-aligned and taper controls share every inference
fixed_factors: only the isolated 100-scene development_screening asset is delivered; candidate confirmation and NH-HAZE remain absent

official ConvIR-B base graph with 8,630,665 frozen parameters and strict checkpoint load
action formula clip(hazy + scale times (official_prediction minus hazy), 0, 1)

the four haze variants are substantive observed conditions and are analyzed separately; no utility transfers across variants

the sole scientific change is grid_definition: each partition is skimage watershed on the Sobel gradient of hazy grayscale with connectivity 1, no watershed line, fixed 32-pixel marker spacing, and one of four fixed phases
partition construction receives hazy RGB only and never GT, official prediction, per-pixel error, clipping, source utility, held-out utility, or outcome

no action outputs or action scales are blended; every selected region action remains one of the same three hard scales
the archived taper projection is recomputed from the same inference and must reproduce parent mean regret 0.1340031213991598 dB within 1e-8 dB
each partition phase is held out once; its GT region oracle is used only after the transferred hard action field is frozen
primary scene regret is the maximum held-out-partition content-aligned regret after equal averaging of four conditioned haze variants
negative control circularly shifts only the dense content-aligned action field by 32 pixels on both axes while preserving action frequencies
non-clipping sensitivity selects content-aligned actions and scores transferred-minus-uniform PSNR on the same action-common non-clipped pixels
same-phase boundary and interior regret use the held-out partition selected by that scene's worst primary regret and are diagnostic only
keep scale 1.0 uses structural array identity; duplicate MSE subtraction is diagnostic only against 64 float64 epsilons
RGB MSE defines action utility and PSNR defines primary outcome; whole-image RGB SSIM and absolute channel-bias define safety
20,000 complete-scene bootstrap resamples use fixed seeds 20260801, 20260802, and 20260803
four haze conditions, partitions, regions, pixels, metrics, and matched taper repeats never increase independent n

primary_estimand.metric: mean canonical-scene maximum-held-out-partition GT-oracle-minus-content-aligned-action PSNR regret after averaging four conditioned haze variants; pass requires one-sided 95 percent scene-bootstrap upper bound below 0.10 dB and upper-bound distance at most 0.05 dB
primary_estimand.aggregation: within each canonical scene and held-out partition average four separately conditioned haze-variant regrets, take the maximum across four held-out partitions, then equal-weight complete-scene bootstrap across 100 scenes

controls: four deterministic marker phases, contiguous nonempty labels, full pixel coverage, exactly three source contributors, finite region utilities, and constant-utility projection invariance are structural gates
an independently calculated small region-projection reference verifies direction, source exclusion, pixel lifting, held-out aggregation, and complete coverage
the matched taper control must reproduce archived parent mean regret within 1e-8 dB from the same official inferences

the gpu_synthetic_no_data fixture must pass each actual model output through all three actions, content-aligned partitions, taper control, held-out scoring, uncertainty, and terminal finalization at full 1200 by 1600 format
keep scale 1.0 must reproduce the official prediction by exact structural array identity
weaken and strengthen outputs must equal the declared affine residual transformation on every non-clipped pixel
the held-out GT region oracle must not have higher RGB MSE than the frozen transferred action field
a 32-pixel circular shift preserves action frequencies but breaks registered local alignment
common non-clipped support uses the same action-neutral mask for source selection and scoring
whole-image SSIM and color evaluation prevents invalid additive region interpretation
hard action agreement, same-phase boundary/interior contrast, held-out phases, clipping strata, region counts, and content-aligned-minus-taper change are diagnostic only

uncertainty.method: 20,000-resample complete-scene bootstrap for continuous means and two-sided 95 percent Wilson intervals for material-benefit and harm prevalences; achieved regret upper-bound distance is reported explicitly

gates.estimand: exact taper evidence identities, isolated 100-scene role, 400 finite inferences, deterministic content-aligned partition and projection structure, matched taper reproduction, keep/affine controls, no protected asset, and no training
one-sided 95 percent complete-scene bootstrap upper bound for worst-held-out-partition content-aligned PSNR regret in dB
distance from the primary point estimate to its one-sided 95 percent upper bound in dB
Wilson lower bound for scenes whose minimum-partition content-aligned-minus-GT-best-uniform PSNR is at least 0.10 dB

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: A pass would show only that this fixed hazy-only edge-watershed spatial unit makes the three-action synthetic development target measurement-stable. A fail with exact taper reproduction would reject this one content-aligned region construction as sufficient and shift the next Stage-1 choice to measurement_target or metric_family; it would not prove every content-adaptive unit invalid or continuous actions necessary. No result identifies deployment-visible predictability, a physical haze mechanism, real-domain transport, or perceptual optimality.

blending action outputs or creating any continuous effective action scale

automatically entering Stage 2; every terminal must first rerun Stage-1 design qualification

precision_contract.rationale: The directly matched taper-regret scene SD is 0.0985213295 dB. The canonical two-sided-normal planning calculation requires 15 independent scenes for a 0.05 dB half-width, so frozen n=100 is feasible without counting variants, partitions, regions, pixels, metrics, or taper repeats.

capability.production_path_statement: The strict-loaded frozen official Haze4K ConvIR-B graph executes four actual forward passes on device-aware 1200 by 1600 no-data haze fixtures; each exact model output then traverses the three hard residual actions, four hazy-only edge-watershed partitions, source-region utility lifting, held-out-region oracle regret, matched taper replay, circular-shift control, same-support non-clipped sensitivity, whole-image PSNR/SSIM/color metrics, same-phase boundary diagnostics, complete-scene bootstrap, Wilson intervals, and typed terminal finalization under a frozen full-scale time bound.

precision.estimand: mean canonical-scene worst-held-out-partition conditional content-aligned PSNR regret
